title: Markdown table of contents
instruction: toc(markdown) in src/toc.js returns the table of contents of the ATX headings of levels 2 and 3 ("## " and "### ", up to three leading spaces allowed) as Markdown list lines joined with "\n": "- [Title](#slug)" for level 2 and "  - [Title](#slug)" for level 3. Headings inside fenced code blocks (``` or ~~~ fences, closed by the same fence kind) are ignored; trailing #'s of a closed heading ("## Title ##") are not part of the title; inline code backticks are removed from the title text. Slugs: lowercase, remove every character that is not a letter, digit, space or hyphen (Unicode letters stay), replace each space with a hyphen; a repeated slug gets "-1", "-2", ... in order of appearance (counting all levels 2-3 headings). No headings: an empty string. Add regression tests.
provenanceNote: Written for pi-eval-loop holdout-v1 by the implementing agent before any optimization run; sealed (SEAL.json) and never mounted into the optimizer's sandbox.
